Alex 10-8 game design philosophy: asymmetric power spikes are fine, 'it's ok to break a few things if everyone has access to broken shit'; balance bands are guardrails, not a flattening.

Alex 10-8 Candlewake look: eyeless hollow shells, hoods/helms of wax giving form to an empty face with a lilac light inside, warlike; canon candlewake_tide.png is the reference (Ringwraith-like, but avoid the famous tells: black riders, spiked crowns, pale blades).

The Review Table now runs fresh code (the old server from Oct 7 was still alive): press K again on the 3 Reed items in art_r3b and re-run Add to canon; the second takes will land this time.

Alex 10-8 design principle: no hard cap boundaries for balance; when aiming at a number, set a target range and tune toward it (e.g. the Candlewake Risen at 10-20% of total force). Within reason: caps that define how a mechanic works are fine; we're not ruled by heuristics.
